name: The Bali Padel Spell
hook: Three padel matches. One ice bath. Sunsets from FINNS to Uluwatu.
priceNote: Price TBA. Pricing, taxes, deposit and booking terms will be announced. Applications are not open yet; no payment is requested.
imageNote: AI-generated Bali-inspired artwork illustrates the atmosphere; it is not photography of the confirmed hotel, padel venue, beach club or performances.
about: Five days in Bali built around the court. Base yourself in Kuta for four nights, play three 90-minute padel matches, recover with a guided ice bath, and spend the golden hours at FINNS Beach Club and on the Uluwatu cliffs for the Kecak & Fire Dance. A half-day in Ubud brings the Tegalalang Rice Terraces, cafés and artisan shops, and the last morning is yours: sunrise yoga or a first surf lesson before the flight home.
stayNote: All four nights are in Kuta, so the padel, Uluwatu and Ubud days return to the same base. The hotel, room category and sharing will be confirmed with pricing.
mealsNote: Daily breakfast at the hotel and four dinners are included: the welcome dinner on Day 1 and dinners on Days 2, 3 and 4. Lunches and beverages are not included.
padelNote: Three 90-minute padel court sessions on Days 2, 3 and 4, with court rental charges included. Equipment details will be confirmed before departure.
transportNote: Airport arrival and departure transfers and a private air-conditioned vehicle with an English-speaking local driver for all sightseeing and transfers are included. International and domestic flights are not included.
